title: comm-compute-handshake-preemption-protector
author: Sofia Alvarez
release_notes: Reduce TP tail latency under preemption by decoupling NCCL progress handshake from compute dispatch; improves small-microbatch tail by ~18-28% depending on topology. No API changes.
review_comments: Marcus Chen: Pin progress worker to a core by default; watch for sys-overhead on multi-tenant rigs.
Ravi Kapoor: Add explicit ncclCommAbort path and unit test to validate communicator cleanup.
Elena Park: Add an integration smoke that simulates preemption (SIGSTOP based).
Infra team (CI): Perf job added; please confirm perf thresholds in checks.yaml.
